summary: Calix, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 8, 2026 reporting that its board of directors increased the existing stock repurchase authorization by an additional $100 million. No price per share, premium, expiration date or specific share count was disclosed. The program permits open-market purchases, privately negotiated transactions and other methods under SEC rules, with timing, price and size dependent on market conditions, and may be suspended or discontinued at any time. This is a discretionary buyback authorization, not a tender offer; no advisor was named. Watch for actual repurchase execution and share-count trajectory in subsequent 10-Qs.
